meta.name: lcx-report-bug
meta.description: Create a high-signal bug issue or PR in the repo that owns the defect. Use this whenever the user asks to report, file, open, or triage a LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, Codex plugin, or upstream Codex CLI bug, especially when they need source-backed root cause, reproduction steps, fix guidance, and GitHub routing.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动创建带根因分析和复现步骤的缺陷报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在GitHub仓库中提交高质量Bug Issue或修复PR。
copy.tagline_en: Automatically create bug reports with root cause analysis and reproduction steps
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to file high-signal bug issues or fix PRs in GitHub repos.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会调查 bug 根因、核对最新源码;复现路径和根因明确后写成英文 GitHub issue(仅 openai/codex 可提 PR),附复现步骤、证据、修复建议和 lazycodex-generated 标签。
howto.when: 当你说要报告、提交或归类 LazyCodex、omo-codex、Codex 相关项目的 bug,尤其是需要根因、复现步骤和 GitHub 归属判断时触发。

say.text: 帮我给 LazyCodex 安装器的 bug 建一个 GitHub issue。
say.note: 它会先查最新源码和运行证据再生成 issue。

say.text: 上报 Codex CLI 配置加载的问题,要复现步骤和根因。
先查一下 LazyCodex 仓库有没有重复的 issue,有就补充证据。
say.note: 匹配到已开 issue 时只评论不重复建。

howto.what_en: Claude investigates, syncs latest sources; once root cause and repro path are concrete, it files an English GitHub issue in the owning repo (PR only for openai/codex) with evidence, fix guidance, and the lazycodex-generated label.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to report, file, or triage a bug in LazyCodex, omo-codex, or other Codex projects, especially when they need root cause, repro steps, and GitHub routing.

say_en.text: Create a GitHub issue for the LazyCodex installer bug.
say_en.note: It syncs latest source and writes an evidence-backed issue.

say_en.text: File a bug about Codex CLI config loading, with repro steps and root cause.
say_en.note: It routes it to the owning repo.

say_en.text: Check the LazyCodex repo for duplicates and add evidence if one exists.
say_en.note: It comments on matches instead of duplicating.
